result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law, so it does not reach either the preferred or fallback position. It also unnecessarily requires all coverage to continue for one year after the term and reorders the existing provisions. The unrelated operative intent is otherwise preserved, and the drafting is generally clear, though “Sparkling’s data” should track the defined term “Customer Data.”
